headline: Polymarket in your terminal
note: The landing-page launch video: one real recording cut in landscape pan mode (render.py, canvas landscape), following the tour in the site caption. Runs in DRY - the order is signed, never posted - and size 5 is the market minimum: the review validates against the real cash balance even in DRY, so a bigger size blocks the order and renders the balance (see record_demo.sh, PR #246). Never record this sheet with execution_live true. The trade tape is shown compact, never expanded with `a`: expanding it pulls a named trader's wallet and positions into the frame. Focus anchors are fractions of the terminal (0 = top/left, 1 = bottom/right) chosen against the 120x38 layout: outcome rail cols 0-36, YES/NO chips rows 4-6, book rows 11-23 cols 37-75, ORDER ticket rows 5-18 cols 78-117, chart rows 25-34, DRY toast row 36. Waits are short on purpose: the header clock repaints every second, so clamp_lag has nothing to cut and the sheet's wall time is the video's.
